title: Canonical finite section and pullback site-comparison arrows
statement: Use the finite purity datum P [def-pur-conventions], actual finite exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the etale/pro-etale comparison morphism nu [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For every morphism b:B′→B of schemes and every ordinary-etale derived coefficient complex K, define pullComparison as the composite of the exact/derived pullback comparisons with the canonical commutation b* nu_B* ≅ nu_B′* b*. For a separated quasi-compact morphism g:V→B smooth of pure relative dimension d≥0 [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], a finite-type k-structure aB on B, and any map s:B→V, define sourceComparison:C_pro(g,s)≅nu_B* C_et(g,s) by specializing the canonical finite section comparison [def-pur-finite-section-comparison] to the sourceSection and sourceEtale presentations of [lem-pur-dnc-section-geometry]. These are the real composition and coefficient-unit comparison arrows; neither DNC invariance nor a chosen isomorphism of their endpoints is part of this definition.

lean.statement:
def sourceComparison (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {V B : Scheme.{u}}
    (d : ℕ) (g : V ⟶ B) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] [IsSeparated g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB]
    (s : B ⟶ V) :
    sourceSection P d g aB s ≅
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) B).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (sourceEtale P d g aB s)
